court_system: NBA full court, feet; origin at left baseline; x in [0,94] (length), y in [0,50] (width); right-basket end
CRUTCH: HAND-CLICKED, EYEBALLED correspondences on ONE frame of a MOVING broadcast camera. These are approximate (easily +/- tens of pixels and several feet), calibrated on frame 1 only, and the clip is an NCAA court (narrower 3pt/lane than the NBA SportVU the encoder was trained on). This is a manual crutch in place of a real homography front-end — NOT a measured registration.

correspondences.label: right baseline x near sideline (bottom-right court corner)
right baseline x far sideline (upper-right court corner)

check_points.label: near lane corner at free-throw line (HELD OUT)
far lane corner at baseline (HELD OUT)

reprojection_note: 4 correspondences fully determine an 8-DOF homography, so their reprojection error is 0 by construction (a tautology, NOT accuracy). check_points are HELD OUT of the fit; their reprojection error is the honest (still-noisy, still-eyeballed) accuracy estimate.
